pairs.subject: page-load-pipeline
pairs.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/CatalogTree.tsx:252 The browser-only chip (className={t.fontMono} on line 250) asks for weight 700. Under the default Blueprint theme, t.fontMono is IBM Plex Mono (theme.ts:30), declared only at 400/500/600 in fonts.ts. So the requested weight has no face, and the browser silently uses 600 or synthesizes a bold.

techniques.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/CatalogTree.tsx:252 A weight is requested that no declared face provides; the technique names this exact failure.

src/components/layout-lab/LayoutLab.tsx:154 The view wrapper's opacity-0 start state is suppressed on first render. The served markup is the settled state, so first paint is not hidden until script runs.

pairs.subject: page-load-pipeline
pairs.evidence: src/hooks/useViewportWidth.ts:58 The shell breakpoint hook renders the wide (1440px) layout first and corrects only after a ResizeObserver callback. On a narrow viewport the first render claims the wrong geometry, then moves.

techniques.evidence: src/hooks/useViewportWidth.ts:58 The first render guesses the layout instead of reserving the real one (a CSS media condition would do that); the narrow case shifts after script.

src/app/layout.tsx:2 next/font serves the files and declarations from the app's own origin, latin subset only, with a metric-adjusted fallback. Geist is a variable font, so every requested weight has a face.
src/app/layout.tsx:6 The only render-blocking resource is one same-origin global stylesheet (the lab-tokens @import is flattened at build time). No third-party tags or head scripts.
src/app/page.tsx:17 The leave guard registers beforeunload (useLeaveGuard.ts:29), not unload; no unload handler exists anywhere under src. It is registered unconditionally, though.

pairs.subject: page-load-pipeline
pairs.evidence: src/components/layout/ShellSkeleton.tsx:13 The first-paint skeleton restates the rail width instead of importing COLLAPSED_WIDTH from SidebarL1.tsx, and reserves only the collapsed rail. SidebarL1 reads l1Expanded, which navigationStore persists with no partialize, so a user who left the rail expanded gets a 56px placeholder followed by a 180px rail.

techniques.evidence: src/components/layout/ShellSkeleton.tsx:13 The placeholder size restates a constant instead of deriving it from the loaded component's source, and ignores the persisted expanded state.
src/components/layout/ModuleRenderer/registry.tsx:13 Module views are code-split and loaded on navigation behind a Suspense boundary, not shipped in the shell's first load.

pairs.subject: page-load-pipeline
pairs.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/fonts.ts:8 The Blueprint mono face is declared at 400/500/600 only, while lab surfaces set in t.fontMono ask for 700 (CatalogTree.tsx:252, StepCrashBoundary.tsx:36, and the matrix table's cells via matrixCellStyle.ts:37). Those requests have no face and fall back silently.

techniques.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/fonts.ts:8 display swap, latin subset and the same-origin next/font are good, but the declared weight set does not cover the weights the styles request (700).

src/components/layout-lab/MatrixSkeleton.tsx:25 The skeleton restates the 30x30 cell size instead of deriving it from matrixCellStyle.ts. It also caps rows at 8 and uses a 20px name cell against the real two-line name cell, so it does not match the loaded geometry.
src/components/layout-lab/LayoutLab.tsx:154 The entrance animation's hidden start state is not applied on first render, so the served and first-painted view is the settled state.
